# The printing press

## The invention

Johannes Gutenberg introduced movable type printing in Europe around 1450. Movable type uses individual metal letters that can be arranged into a page, inked and reused. Before this, books in Europe were copied by hand, which made them slow and costly to produce. The first major book printed with the new method was a Latin Bible.

## Effects

Printing lowered the cost of books and made them available to more readers. The number of printed titles grew quickly during the following decades. Reformers such as Martin Luther used printed pamphlets to spread their ideas widely. Standard printed texts also helped to fix spelling and grammar in many languages.
